title: Unraveling the Osteogenic Activity and Molecular Mechanism of an Antioxidant Collagen Peptide in MC3T3-E1 Cells.
authors: Wang, Yali; Wang, Yue; Zhuang, Xiaoyan; Zhang, Yonghui; Fang, Baishan; Fu, Yousi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究抗氧化胶原肽UU1在成骨细胞中的促成骨与抗凋亡活性，分子对接仅涉及肽-EGFR/整合素，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Background: Osteoporosis has become an inevitable health issue with global aging, and the current drug treatments often have adverse side effects, highlighting the need for safer and more effective therapies. Collagen-derived peptides are promising alternatives due to their favorable safety profile and biological activity. This study aimed to investigate the osteogenic and anti-apoptotic properties of collagen peptide UU1 (GASGPMGPR) in addition to its antioxidant activity. Methods: The effects of UU1 were evaluated in MC3T3-E1 cells by assessing osteogenic markers, including alkaline phosphatase (ALP), Cyclin D1, runt-related transcription factor 2 (Runx2), and Akt/beta-catenin signaling. Western blot analysis quantified collagen I, osteocalcin, and phosphorylated Akt levels. Anti-apoptotic effects were measured via p-Akt levels and the Bax/Bcl-2 ratio. Computational molecular docking was performed to explore the molecular mechanism of UU1 via its interaction with epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) and collagen-binding integrin. Results: UU1 treatment promoted cell differentiation, with elevated ALP, Cyclin D1, Runx2, and Akt/beta-catenin signaling. Notably, at 0.025 mg/mL, UU1 upregulated the levels of collagen I, osteocalcin, and phosphorylated Akt by 2.14, 3.37, and 1.95 times, respectively, compared to the control. Additionally, UU1 exhibited anti-apoptotic effects, indicated by increased p-Akt levels and a reduced Bax/Bcl-2 ratio. Molecular docking analysis suggested that UU1 could assist the dimerization of EGFR, facilitating downstream signaling transductions and activating collagen-binding integrin. Conclusions: These findings highlight UU1 as a multifunctional peptide with antioxidant, osteogenic, and anti-apoptotic properties, positioning it as a promising candidate for anti-osteoporosis applications in the food and pharmaceutical industries.
abstract_zh: 背景：随着全球老龄化，骨质疏松症已成为不可避免的健康问题，而目前的药物治疗常伴有不良副作用，凸显了对更安全有效疗法的需求。胶原蛋白衍生肽因其良好的安全性和生物活性而成为有前景的替代选择。本研究旨在探讨胶原蛋白肽UU1（GASGPMGPR）的促成骨和抗凋亡特性，以及其抗氧化活性。方法：在MC3T3-E1细胞中评估UU1的作用，通过检测成骨标志物，包括碱性磷酸酶（ALP）、细胞周期蛋白D1、runt相关转录因子2（Runx2）和Akt/β-catenin信号通路。Western blot分析定量了I型胶原蛋白、骨钙素和磷酸化Akt水平。通过p-Akt水平和Bax/Bcl-2比值测量抗凋亡效果。进行了计算分子对接，以探索UU1通过其与表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）和胶原结合整合素的相互作用所涉及的分子机制。结果：UU1处理促进了细胞分化，ALP、Cyclin D1、Runx2和Akt/β-catenin信号通路水平升高。值得注意的是，在0.025 mg/mL浓度下，与对照组相比，UU1将I型胶原蛋白、骨钙素和磷酸化Akt的水平分别上调了2.14、3.37和1.95倍。此外，UU1表现出抗凋亡作用，表现为p-Akt水平升高和Bax/Bcl-2比值降低。分子对接分析提示，UU1可能协助EGFR的二聚化，促进下游信号转导并激活胶原结合整合素。结论：这些发现突显了UU1作为一种多功能肽，具有抗氧化、促成骨和抗凋亡特性，使其成为食品和制药行业中抗骨质疏松应用的有前景候选物。
